title: One complete bilingual Word brief, method/formulas, then ALL annotated existing Python code per lab, including Pretest
contract: One ORIGINAL Word file maps to one complete docs/labs/<slug>.md, not multiple task-answer alternations and no independent Python file.

Four contiguous sections in exact order: (1) full English assignment in original task order including all tables/datasets, (2) full Vietnamese translation (including tables/units/numbers), (3) detailed Vietnamese walkthrough for every task and all relevant formulas, (4) ONE complete executable Python script with thorough in-code comments/notes.

All Python source from existing labs/pythoclass/<slug>/SOLUTION.py, existing annotated historic scripts, or genuine PythoClass demos/lessons. Preserve implemented algorithms and values; disclose provenance accurately. Do not invent algorithms or claim reviewed solutions were the user's personally written demo.

For source briefs use original Word-derived LAB.md. Disclose that this is a faithful existing transcription instead of claiming binary docx was re-read. Do not omit any original task/table and do not silently 'fix' conflicting Lab04 electricity bill example.

Include Pretest.docx as eighth Word unit. It is currently available only as a private binary whose contents retrieval fails with UnicodeDecodeError in the connected GitHub text interface. NEVER fabricate its requirements. Keep Pretest BLOCKED_SOURCE_BINARY until legible source is fetched through an authorized, verified path.

Earlier Word lab publication is superseded by the new layout; preserve full Git history. Use at most three source Word labs per PR, exact final GitHub CI success and stable base before merge. Complete goal only when all 8 documents have grounded content and CI proof.
Keep PythoClass unchanged and avoid exposing student identities. Windows/CDP worker verification UNVERIFIED unless actually tested.
blocker: Pretest.docx is private binary. Connected GitHub text-only access returns UnicodeDecodeError; actual original questions unavailable, no Pretest solution generated.
